reviews.x: The aroma presented by this massage oil has both calming and exotic flavor to the senses.  As being a present worthy of the King of Kings I had never smelled the two scents in combination...Heavenly is my response and I highly recommend this for either personal massage or to bring to your own masseuse.

Tried this oil for peripheral neuropathy pain and it helped more than anything else I have tried. It has a strong smell of lavender which was very relaxing to me. It starts out oily when you first put it on but after a few minutes the oil is absorbed so it doesn't mess up the bed sheets. It also made my feet smooth and soft. I recommend it for neuropathy pain.

reviews.t: Zum, zum zummy!!! This is such a beautiful oil!
reviews.x: If you haven't tried this oil, get it today!  It is the BEST oil EVER!  And I've used a lot of oils.  It is so, so very richly scented, and the scent is like nothing else I've ever smelled.  It moisturizes so well that I feel like Cleopatra must have felt with all of her pampering and love of oils.  Some reviewers have noted that the scent is too strong and overpowering, which really may be accurate.  It isn't, though that the smell itself is overpowering, it is that it is so richly scented that

I was looking forward to this product as I use Zum detergent and soap.  Besides the oil leaking out, the smell was amazing.  I am out the oil and the money, which is why I’m leaving this review.  There was no option to replace item.  I don’t feel like I should have to go through trouble of returning an empty bottle.

My absolute favorite. I have severely damaged & dry skin on my arms & this oil is the only thing that keeps my skin reasonably supple. The oil mix is heavy but it absorbs nicely within a very few minutes, it's not a 'smear-and-go' oil but you also don't have to wait around before getting dressed. I can dress about 5 minutes after using it without worrying about messing up my clothes and the few times I've pulled my sleeves down right after application any oil that may have gotten on them didn't
I use every night as a lotion for sunspots on my chest and they are getting better.  Tanks dr. Oz.
This is one of those oils I would buy again. It smells great, nice to put on after you shave your legs or just rub on to smell nice.

I was just introduced to the Zum Oil after purchasing the EDT and Mist.  Great oil and calming to the soul.  My skin is dry and flaky from chemotherapy treatments so I used the Zum Oil, Balm, Mist, Lotion and EDT as it makes me feel relaxed and peaceful.  The scent is long lasting in all forms.  In all I highly reommend ALL of the ZUM Frankincense and  Myrhh products for their calming and healing properties.  This particular fragrance smells wonderful.

Wow, I have already reordered this product. It is just what I was hoping for and high quality. Lasts for a long time even though we use it every day. I wish it came in a bigger size. It isn't strong but is fresh and light.

reviews.t: Fantastic scent when purchased in a retail outlet
reviews.x: Fantastic scent when purchased in a retail outlet. This vendor however is very, very sketchy. BUYER BEWARE: what I received is markedly different than what I'm used to. The UPC was lined thru by a marker. My theory is, they've swapped the good stuff with inferior oil. This smelled pretty unpleasant and the color is different than what I'm used to getting at Whole Foods. Will NEVER purchase from this vendor again!

I used this product to make Gold, Frankencense and Myrrh soap to give as small gifts at Christmas. It worked great. Delivery was fast, product was well packaged and in perfect condition. Met and exceeded expectations.  The soap was really supposed to be for display, but many people said it lathered beautifully and they loved the fragrance and wanted more!! It has an earthy, relaxing aroma, reminiscent of patchouli , although much more subtle. Not a fruity or flowery smell. The oil is primarily a

This product is certainly my favorite oil I have ever used, as well as my fav product from Indigo Wild. F&M is such a relaxing and rejuvenating scent to have as a body oil. I can totally understand why F&M continues to be a best selling product in much of the Zum line of products. After buying this oil direct from Indigo Wild for over 3 years, I have sadly found that shipping their products to me now is extremely expensive. So sadly I have had to go without Zum for quite a while until a friend t

I love the scent and blend of the skin loving oils made by Indigo Wild. The Frankincense and Myrrh is my favorite. Easy to apply and great for self massage. The scent is obviously Indigo Wild's proprietary blend and I added 25 drops of Frankincense esstential oil to the bottle to give it an extra health boost. One of the bottles leaked all inside the shipping box, and the seller promptly made it right by refunding the price paid for the leaking bottle. I have used the body mist, soap and laundry

reviews.t: Not the same size as I ordered last time
reviews.x: I had purchased an 8oz bottle of this and loved it. I clicked on the same order expecting the same size. My bad I didn't notice the 4 oz! The price seemed about right and had not noticed. It is small and not even filled to the top! The product itself is the same and smells so good! I know things are going up, but that is ridiculous! Buyer beware!
I'll never know how or if this product works. Arrived in a damaged bottle that all of the contents out. The box it came in smells great tho...

I've had this for about a week or so.  My kids and I are using it instead of lotion, after showers and before bedtime.  It doesn't leave a grease trail like others. This was the first time I bought this product and now I'm in love with their whole line of products.

Wonderful massage oil. I had hoped that it would help the nerve pain in my feet, but all it did was warm them up. Doesn't mean though that it isn't great for massages though. I definitely recommend it for that and the smell is very pleasant.

I did not so much enjoy this product. The scent is very strong and the oil is very thick and takes a while to absorb. If you're looking for a light oil this is not it, but if you're into rich oils you may love this product.

reviews.t: Not quite what I hoped for
reviews.x: If you're hoping for a church type incense fragrance, this isn't it.  The oil itself is nice enough but the scent to me is like a pumped up version of Avon Skin so Soft bath oil.  Not bad, just not what I was hoping for.

The frankincense and myrrh massage oil does not have the same scent as the frankincense and myrrh bar soap. The bottle I received smells more like citrus and honey. The bar soap has more frankincense and myrrh scent.

reviews.t: I like the product but the pump was very challenging to ...
reviews.x: I like the product but the pump was very challenging to get to open up.  I almost returned it but instead got very aggressive with the top/pump to the point where I felt like I was going to break it when it finally popped up.  There was no rhyme or reason to getting it open.  The little "open" arrow wasn't any help and didn't have anything to do with the thing finally opening.

reviews.t: Indigo Wild Zum Massage OIl, Frankincense and Myrrh
reviews.x: I love this scent.  Sometimes I put just a dab on my arms with my other lotion.  A dab goes a long way.  I love walking into the room where I've been and smelling the lingering scent.
This is my favorite of the Zum line- it lasts a long while and gives off a mysterious aroma with my body chemistry-*may be too strong for some, but I love it 💜💙
The oil is good for massage, but I was hoping that it would be more fragrant. If you are looking for a fragrant massage oil, this is not the one!
If you can not take strong smelling perfumes DO NOT BUY THIS!  It is very strong to the nose and takes my breath away. So I could not use it.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent as wonderful, relaxing, and long-lasting.
Many reviewers report the oil absorbs well after a few minutes and moisturizes dry or damaged skin effectively.
Several reviewers describe the product as their favorite oil and would buy or have bought it again.
A few reviewers report receiving leaking or damaged bottles, sometimes with no replacement option.
One reviewer suspects the product received from this vendor differs from retail versions and warns buyers.
